hood.name: Coring head hood
hood.desc: Lift for access to the coring head, tine holders and turf guards. Keep hands clear: lower the head and stop the engine before working under it.

head.name: Coring head, crank arms and tine holders
head.desc: Sealed bearings, no grease fittings. Head bearing kit 131-4876: inspect every 500 h and yearly. Torque the coring-head fasteners at 8 h and every 250 h; tine holder bolts 40.6 N.m. Replace damaged tines with the same length. Calibrate tine ground height before aerating.

guards.name: Turf guards
guards.desc: Match the guards to the tine head: 3-tine short 120-1044, 4-tine short 120-1045 / long 120-1046, 5-tine short 120-1047, 6-tine 120-1050 to 120-1053.

roller.name: Roller
roller.desc: Check it turns freely and is clean of cores before each use.

handle.name: Tiller handle and controls
handle.desc: Test the safety interlocks and parking brake daily. Torque the tiller handle fasteners at 8 h and every 250 h.

engine.name: Engine: Kohler CH680 Command PRO V-twin
engine.desc: Toro part 161-9175, 2 plugs. Oil 1.9 L (API SJ+, Toro Premium 10W-30). Oil and filter first at 50 h, then every 100 h. Air cleaner: wash and oil the foam pre-filter every 25 h, replace the paper element every 100 h. In-line fuel filter 115-7854 every 100 h. Plugs Champion RC12YC 0.75 mm, 27 N.m: check every 200 h. Clear the engine screen daily. Oil filter and air elements come through Kohler: buy by engine spec CH680-3165.

drive.name: Drive belts and hydraulics
drive.desc: Reservoir 6.6 L Toro PX Extended Life. Change the fluid and both filters (75-1310 and 107-9531) every 400 h (200 h if not on PX). Adjust the pump belt at 8 h; inspect all belts yearly: idler belt 107-7513, banded clutch belt 140-8882, 3V belt 105-0989.

wheel.name: Drive wheel (left)
wheel.desc: Tyre 83 kPa (12 psi), check every 50 h. Lug nuts 61-75 N.m at 8 h and every 250 h.

battery.name: 12 V battery
battery.desc: Wet, 300 CCA, Toro 99-7421. Check the cable connections yearly.

telematics.name: Telematics gateway
telematics.desc: Gateway 161-9001 is listed for this model. It needs activating by the Toro distributor; Intelli360 currently shows the ProCore at 0 h, so check it is reporting.

Kohler oil filter.name: Engine oil filter (Kohler CH680)
Kohler oil filter.note: Not in the Toro catalog. Order from a Kohler dealer by engine spec CH680-3165.

Kohler air elements.name: Air filter paper element + foam pre-filter (Kohler)
Kohler air elements.note: Retail listings pair Kohler 24 083 03-S with its pre-filter: confirm with a Kohler dealer by spec number before stocking.
